# Theme changelog — 2026-07-13

## yt-videos-list slider arrows: touch-target size (Lighthouse a11y "Touch targets do not have sufficient size or spacing")
- Extended the scoped `.videos-list .swiper-prev/.swiper-next` button reset with `min-width/min-height: 44px` + inline-flex centering — arrow icons unchanged, tap area now 44×44 (audit minimum is 24×24). The overlapped `.product-link` flags should clear with the arrows compliant (spec counts a target's unobscured area); if the re-run still pairs them, next step is repositioning arrows off the product card (visible change, needs design decision).
- Prior related fix (user-applied in a separate session): review-cards pagination bullets restyled as 24×4 bars — passes via WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception (bar centers 32px apart > 24px circle requirement).
- Section is live on the homepage. Synced to shopify-dev.

## Image delivery fixes (Lighthouse perf "Improve image delivery", est. 326 KiB — groups 1-3 ≈ 270 KiB addressed)
- **snippets/product-grid-item.liquid (sitewide, ~200 KiB):** the auto-built `sizes` attribute claimed 2-column widths until 1400px while the CSS grid goes desktop-columns at 990px — browsers on 990-1399px viewports fetched 720px files for ~228px slots. Added a `(min-width: 990px)` clause with `columns_desktop` math to all four formula variants (kept the 80vw capped-wrapper clause for ≥1400px).
- **sections/review-swiper-card.liquid (homepage, ~47 KiB):** hardcoded `width: 400` for 145px thumbnails → now `srcset` 150/300/450w + `sizes="145px"` + width/height attrs.
- **sections/meet-nikol.liquid (homepage, ~25 KiB):** image had no width/srcset (raw 800px original for a ~533px slot) → `srcset` 400/600/800w + `sizes="(min-width: 750px) 50vw, calc(100vw - 32px)"` + width/height attrs (also helps CLS).
- Group 4 (slideshow banner + image-grid, ~55 KiB) intentionally left: normal srcset step granularity, not worth denser steps.
- All three synced to shopify-dev. Verify after push: homepage product grids/review cards/Meet Nikol look unchanged; PageSpeed image-delivery savings should drop to ~55 KiB.

## Hotfix: review-swiper-card thumbnails distorted
- The width/height attributes added with the srcset fix were applied literally — `.product-image` CSS constrains width but not height, so the height attribute stretched the images. Attributes removed (srcset/sizes fix unchanged); meet-nikol's attributes verified safe (its CSS sets both dims + object-fit: cover). Synced to shopify-dev.

## Image delivery round 2: sizes attributes corrected for the 1100px wrapper cap
Root cause of the remaining over-fetching: `.wrapper` is capped at `--content-max: 1100px` on 990-1399px viewports (80vw above that), but three `sizes` attributes assumed full-viewport content:
- `snippets/product-grid-item.liquid`: all four auto-`sizes` formulas now use `min(100vw, 1100px)` in the 990px clause (80vw ≥1400px clauses unchanged).
- `sections/meet-nikol.liquid`: sizes now exact — `(min-width: 1145px) 533px` (inner max-width 1145px, 50% col − 40px padding), `calc(50vw - 40px)` below.
- `sections/section-blog.liquid`: grid clause capped with `min(100vw, 1100px)` (the two 3600px article images on the dev homepage — section enabled there via editor, not in repo homepage template).
Left as-is: slideshow banner (srcset step granularity, ~25 KiB). Expected audit result: ~99 → ~25 KiB. All synced to shopify-dev.

## Font loading consolidated (Lighthouse "Network dependency tree" 859ms chain + ">4 preconnects" warning)
- The theme loaded Cormorant + Inter TWICE: from Shopify's font CDN (theme settings `cormorant_n5`/`inter_n4` via font-settings.css.liquid) AND from Google Fonts (agency-added stylesheet link — the entire critical chain: HTML → fonts.googleapis.com CSS → 859ms woff2).
- `assets/font-settings.css.liquid`: added the weights only the Google copy provided — Inter 300/500/600 + Cormorant 600 — via `font_modify` + `font_face` (swap), each guarded with `{% if %}`.
- `layout/theme.liquid`: removed the Google Fonts stylesheet link + the fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com preconnects (theme preconnects now 2: cdn.shopify.com + fonts.shopifycdn.com; remaining preconnects are app-injected via content_for_header).
- Verified zero remaining Google Fonts references in the theme. Synced both files to shopify-dev.
- Verify after push: homepage typography vs live — especially light (300) body text and semibold (600) headings; same families/weights now served from fonts.shopifycdn.com.

## Mobile image delivery round 3: columns_mobile string bug (PSI mobile "Improve image delivery" 461 KiB)
- Root cause: sections using Broadcast's named mobile layouts store `layout_mobile: "slider"`/`"carousel"` — and both `section-collection.liquid` (line 41) and `product-grid-item.liquid`'s sizes fallback compute mobile columns via `| plus: 0`, which turns those strings into 0 → default 1 column → mobile `sizes` claimed full-viewport images while the slider renders ~2-up (~48vw) → every product image fetched at 720-960px for ~348px slots.
- Fixed in `snippets/product-grid-item.liquid` (the file that actually builds `sizes`): when `grid_mobile` is absent, fall back to `layout_mobile` — numeric values pass through, `slider`/`carousel` map to 2 columns; final default 1 unchanged. Benefits all product grids sitewide; no visual change.
- section-collection's own `--COLUMNS-MOBILE: 0` var left as-is (slider CSS ignores it; separate cosmetic quirk, not rendering-affecting).
- Synced to shopify-dev. Mobile report context (score 30, LCP 8.9s): Google Fonts chain fixes are in repo but weren't pushed when this report ran — push then re-run mobile PSI.

## main.css dead-rule sweep + embedded-sourcemap removal (244.7KB → 55.0KB raw, −77%)
- **Dead rules removed (169, ~16KB):** legacy section families (left-right-content, hero-slider__*, image-content, prefooter, about-quote-image scraps, instagram-feed), stale stock-component selectors (modal__outer, icon-profile, search-popdown__*, cart-drawer__message/head, product__tabs, quick-add__button-mobile, main-menu--active, sold-out-box, product-item__swatched__holder etc. — each hand-verified: existing near-miss names are different classes), and agency utility classes (fs-*/fc-*/fw-*/bttn*/td-underline/w-100/ff-cormorant + #policy standard/text rules) — verified absent from all 29 store pages' HTML via Admin API (read-only).
- **KEPT per rules:** wp-caption + shopthepost-widget (article-content risk, 797 articles unscanned), all wishlist (wh-*/wsh_qty/wishlist-advanced-option), Rush #rush-product-list.
- **styles.css (12.7 → 11.4KB):** #buddha-crosssell .bcsell-* rules removed per user decision (uninstalled app's widget, force-hidden elsewhere anyway).
- **THE BIG ONE — embedded sourcemap:** main.css began with the complete sourcemap JSON pasted raw (version/sources/names/mappings/file/sourcesContent — full escaped copy of all 64 SCSS sources, 173.4KB) — invalid CSS discarded by browser error recovery but downloaded render-blocking by every visitor on every page. Verified before removal: valid standalone JSON with exactly the sourcemap-spec keys; parsed CSS selector list byte-identical with/without (483=483); main.css only ever loaded as a stylesheet. Blob + dangling `sourceMappingURL=main.css.map` comment (map file doesn't exist) removed.
- Expected transfer: ~36KB → ~10-12KB gz, directly cutting the 2,450ms mobile render-block. Both files synced to shopify-dev. Verify: full visual pass on dev (homepage, collection, PDP, blog, policy page).

## Hotfix: custom-product-slider images stretched to fixed 400px height
- `image_tag` auto-emits width/height attributes; the section CSS overrode width (`width: 100%`) but not height, so the `height` attribute applied literally and stretched the images vertically. Added `height: auto` to `.custom-product-slider__img a img`. Same bug class as the 07-13 review-swiper-card distortion — attribute dimensions need BOTH axes handled in CSS (either height:auto or object-fit).
- Synced to shopify-dev.

## Image-distortion sweep: all image_tag/fixed-dimension img sites audited
- Checked every custom/agency section's image CSS against the attribute-dimensions trap (the review-swiper + product-slider bug class). All handled correctly (height:auto or object-fit pairing) except one: `custom-steps-horizontal` — added `height: auto` to `.custom-steps-horizontal__image img` (was contain-protected against stretching but the image box took attribute height → letterbox whitespace risk). Section is dormant (coming-soon + homepage-style-2 templates only) — preventive fix, no visible change anywhere today.
- Verified safe as-is: custom-guarantee-list, custom-steps-vertical, custom-icon-features, custom-hero-banner (live homepage — untouched), coming-soon mp-* icons, cart-line-items, custom-feature-hero. Synced to shopify-dev.

## Render-blocking CSS: styles.css merged + swiper.css async (PSI "Render-blocking requests", ~1.1s of 1.81s est.)
- **styles.css merged into main.css** (66.7KB raw combined) and deleted; its `stylesheet_tag` removed from theme.liquid — one fewer blocking request (~480ms mobile). Cascade preserved: styles.css's Swiper-component overrides win on specificity, not order.
- **swiper.css now loads async** (`media="print" onload="this.media='all'"` + noscript fallback; preload_tag kept so the download still starts early). All Swiper UI is below the fold; homepage slideshow is Flickity (theme.css), unaffected.
- **FOUC remedy (user-designed):** Swiper's three structural core rules (.swiper overflow/position, .swiper-wrapper flex, .swiper-slide flex-shrink) copied verbatim into main.css before the merged styles — the pre-swiper.css frame renders slides in a row instead of stacked, and the async file re-applies identical values (no shift). Section CSS already styles all visible slider chrome.
- NOT deferred (deliberate): theme.css (core, FOUC), font-settings.css (fonts must start downloading early), swatches.css (Liquid-generated, product grids), accelerated-checkout css (Shopify-injected).
- Synced to shopify-dev (styles.css deleted there too). Verify on dev: homepage sliders styled correctly on first paint + after scroll; review-cards bullets/guarantee list unchanged.

## Minified asset pipeline: theme loads .min copies, readable sources stay
- Generated via esbuild (`scripts/minify-assets.mjs`, committed to repo): **theme.min.css 562→446KB (−21%), main.min.css 67→47KB (−30%), main.min.js 8.5→4.1KB (−51%)**. theme.js/vendor.js are already-minified bundles (0% gain) and swiper.css gains <2% — left loading their originals to keep the drift surface minimal.
- References switched in theme.liquid (preload + stylesheet + main.js script), password.liquid, gift_card.liquid. Verified zero remaining loads of the non-min three. Readable sources remain in assets, unused by any template.
- **WORKFLOW RULE: after any edit to theme.css / main.css / main.js, run `node scripts/minify-assets.mjs`** — it regenerates the .min files and syncs them to shopify-dev. (This is exactly how the old orphaned main.min.css went stale — the script + memory rule exist to prevent a repeat.)
- esbuild flagged 3 `*zoom: 1` IE6-hack properties in theme.css (dropped in min output — dead for all modern browsers, no effect).

- **KEPT deliberately:** jquery.fancybox (auto-binds to `data-fancybox` content markup — 29 pages verified clean via Admin API but 797 article bodies unscannable; 13KB non-index only), shuffle.min.js (used by main.js on the videos page), Yotpo loader (app), jQuery core.
- Accepted (documented, no action): theme.js unused fraction (stock bundle), wpm (Shopify web pixels), GTM container 63.5KB (marketing decision, audit inside GTM admin), swiper-bundle unused fraction, theme.css unused-CSS flag (whole-site stylesheet vs single page).
- Synced to shopify-dev. Verify after push: any non-homepage page with a <select> dropdown (contact form?) still renders/works — native selects should appear (selectboxit never ran, so nothing visually changes).
- Follow-up: 3 `.about-contact__form .selectboxit-*` rules purged from main.css (2.3KB — previously kept by the CSS sweep because the class names existed inside selectboxit.js; provably dead now that the plugin is gone). Minified assets regenerated via scripts/minify-assets.mjs (main.min.css 45.2KB).
